record.bible_text: And the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> set forward<WH05265><WTH8799>, and pitched<WH02583><WTH8799> in the plains<WH06160> of Moab<WH04124> on this side<WH05676> Jordan<WH03383> <FI>by<Fi> Jericho<WH03405>.
